newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 195,000 barrels in the week ended February 19 to 10.255 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks fell by 1.078 million barrels to 7.786 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks up 478,000 barrels to 5.916 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
